name: bld6_poly_mul_add_one_eq_pow_const
statement: {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (f h : Polynomial k) (heq : f * (f + 1) = h ^ n) : f.natDegree = 0
closed: ∀ {k : Type*} [Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) (f h : Polynomial k) (heq : f * (f + 1) = h ^ n), f.natDegree = 0
informal: Uses Mathlib2.poly_no_consecutive_powerful: f and f+1 are coprime, so in the UFD k[X] any irreducible p dividing f has p-adic multiplicity in f equal to its multiplicity in h^n, a multiple of n ≥ 2, hence p^2 ∣ f; same for f+1. Both powerfulness hypotheses of poly_no_consecutive_powerful hold, giving natDegree f = 0 (last step).
type: ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field k] [DecidableEq k] [CharZero k] (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → ∀ (f h : Polynomial k), f * (f + 1) = h ^ n → f.natDegree = 0
